column1: # Croatian (hr) catalog for the whole CFA4 interface (Qt GUI and egui). Same format as es.tsv:
# context <TAB> source <TAB> translation.
# Clean-room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label using ordinary
# Croatian video-editing vocabulary (vremenska crta, traka, isječak, sekvenca, mapa, glava za
# reprodukciju, oznaka, prijelaz, ključni kadar). No proprietary localisation resource, string
# table or product UI was consulted or copied; add entries the same way. Commands are imperatives
# ("Spremi kao…"), labels use sentence case, quotation marks are „…”, and product and format names
# (CFA4, Lumetri, ProRes, AAF, EDL…) keep their spelling. Decimal comma (0,5). A native-speaker
# review is welcome.
# Terms: clip = isječak, track = traka, sequence = sekvenca, timeline = vremenska crta, bin = mapa,
# playhead = glava za reprodukciju, marker = oznaka, label = etiketa, In/Out point = ulazna/izlazna
# točka, keyframe = ključni kadar, caption = titl, preset = spremljena postavka, template =
# predložak, workspace = radni prostor, gain = pojačanje, opacity = neprozirnost, render =
# renderiranje, ripple = s pomakom, dissolve = pretapanje, wipe = brisanje, voice-over = naracija,
# proxy = proxy, guide = vodilica, shortcut = prečac, (Legacy) = (stari).
# Licence: GPL-3.0-or-later (CFA4 contributors), except the section imported from craft-i18n at
# the end (MIT OR Apache-2.0); see hr.tsv.attribution.
